facts: A18 changes no application code, schema (v6), protocol or CSP; it adds host measurement, rolling-release and chaos tooling run by the UTS.

Budgets cover startup, idle Pss, idle CPU, idle context switches, XDG/profile/backup disk and doctor/backup latency over a 10k-card / 100k-pending-change fixture seeded through the checked-in migration line.
Invariants always enforced: zero inet sockets while idle and zero processes alive 5 s after SIGTERM to the main process.
Numeric budgets are proposed and reported, not enforced, until a release-profile run on the reference host calibrates them; debug runs use debugAllowance multipliers and are indicative only.
The rolling canary baseline is promoted only from a UTS run whose results.json is overall pass; broken loader state is diagnosed, never repaired.

Chaos covers freeze-thaw (SIGSTOP/SIGCONT), hard kill, second-instance storm, missing session bus and unprivileged offline network namespace; real systemd suspend, clock jumps and relay reconnect are not claimed.
Cloud Xvfb runs against the real debug and release binaries passed every probe; they are plumbing evidence, not budget evidence.
